verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a skill format, repository, and distribution ecosystem rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party MCP server that exposes Skills to external agents. What it does show is client-side MCP support in Claude Code (docs-57, docs-81), plugins that can bundle third-party MCP servers, and an Agent SDK in-process MCP primitive for building custom tools; none of these count toward this story.
